oracle: msb secret-list from the acq store: each entry reports scope/service/value_state and the ENV@HOST binding msb would use (the usai trust anchor, and a --host/--env custom endpoint), never a value; a service msb cannot bind is refused before it is stored

argv: import json, subprocess, sys; value = sys.stdin.buffer.read(); acq = sys.argv[2:]; run = lambda args, feed: subprocess.run(acq + args, input=value if feed else b'', capture_output=True); check = lambda args, want, p: (value and (value in p.stdout or value in p.stderr) and sys.exit('vector driver: the secret value appeared in acq output')) or (want is not None and p.returncode != want and sys.exit('vector driver: %s exited %d, expected %d' % (' '.join(args), p.returncode, want))) or p; p = [check(args, want, run(args, feed)) for args, feed, want in json.loads(sys.argv[1])][-1]; sys.stdout.buffer.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.buffer.write(p.stderr); sys.exit(p.returncode)
